system.description:
Once per round, call your shot before you swing.

  • Roll a d4 alongside your attack; if the hit lands and the d4 comes up 3 or better, choose one: knock the target Prone, disarm it, push it 10ft, blind it until the end of its next turn, or give it Disadvantage on its next attack.
  • The target resists with a save against your Class Save DC, using Strength or Dexterity, whichever is higher: Fortitude against Prone, a push or a disarm, Reflex against blinding, Will against the attack penalty.
  • A creature more than one size larger than you ignores the deed.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

activities.name: Deed die (1d4)
activities.text: Roll alongside your attack: on a hit with 3 or better, choose a deed.

activities.name: Prone, push or disarm
activities.text: Knock it Prone, push it 10ft or disarm it, unless it passes a Fortitude save. A creature more than one size larger than you ignores the deed.

activities.name: Blind
activities.text: Blind it until the end of its next turn, unless it passes a Reflex save. A creature more than one size larger than you ignores the deed.

activities.name: Attack penalty
activities.text: Disadvantage on its next attack, unless it passes a Will save. A creature more than one size larger than you ignores the deed.
